name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers what you built and decided in past sessions instead of starting from zero every time.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev agency running Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI coding tools on long-running client projects, who is tired of re-explaining context every session.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder running week-long AI coding sessions keeps the agent consistent on architecture decisions made three weeks ago without re-pasting old chats.
A dev agency bills clients for 'AI pair-programming' retainers and uses persistent memory to make the agent feel like a dedicated team member who remembers the codebase's history.
A bootcamp or course creator packages it as part of an 'AI dev environment' starter kit for students working on multi-week capstone projects.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted, team-shared memory service for AI coding agents, billed per seat so whole teams share agent context.
Paid setup/consulting for agencies wiring persistent memory into their AI coding workflow across multiple client repos.

steal_this: Package a one-command 'memory onboarding' script that developers run on a fresh clone of a client's repo to instantly give any AI agent working context from the git history and docs.
